articles.title: When are September Social Security checks coming? It starts to get tricky very soon
articles.summary: Here’s a breakdown of what’s about to happen and why.
articles.body:
Moneywise and Yahoo Finance LLC may earn commission or revenue through links in the content below.

For those receiving benefits from the Social Security Administration (SSA), the next few months are about to become a bit complicated. While September's Social Security payment schedule is relatively straightforward, October is where things begin to get confusing.

Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients will see two deposits during October (1), but the second isn't a bonus. Another group will receive its regular Social Security payment one day early — and then the government is expected to reveal the 2027 cost-of-living adjustment (COLA), which won't actually take effect until next year.

Jeff Bezos backs a platform that lets anyone invest in rental homes for as little as $100 — 6 ways to build wealth like a landlord without actually being one

JPMorgan sees gold hitting $5,000/oz by Q4 — and savvy investors are protecting their wealth with a tax-advantaged Gold IRA. Get your free guide from Priority Gold

The tax breaks in Trump's 'big beautiful bill' expire after 2028. Here are 4 moves to make before the window closes

With all of this going on at once, it's easy to feel confused. Here's a breakdown of what's about to happen and why.

September's Social Security payment schedule

Most Social Security retirement, survivor and disability payments are distributed according to the beneficiary's birthday.

People born between the first and 10th day of the month generally receive their benefits on the second Wednesday of each month. Those born from the 11th through 20th are paid on the third Wednesday, while those born after the 20th are paid on the fourth Wednesday.

However, SSI follows a different schedule. It's generally paid on the first day of the month, while people who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 — along with certain beneficiaries who receive both Social Security and SSI — are normally paid on the third.

According to the SSA's 2026 calendar, September payments will arrive on the following dates:

Thursday, Sept. 3: People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 and certain beneficiaries receiving both Social Security and SSI

Wednesday, Sept. 9: Beneficiaries born from the first through 10th

Wednesday, Sept. 16: Beneficiaries born from the 11th through 20th

Wednesday, Sept. 23: Beneficiaries born from the 21st through 31st

Knowing when your money arrives is only half the job. You also have to make it last until the next payment, even while rent, utilities and recurring charges come due on their own schedules.

articles.title: How boyfriend's engagement to another woman drove Bengaluru techie to jump to death from PG terrace
articles.summary: BENGALURU: A 23-year-old software engineer died and her 30-year-old boyfriend sustained serious injuries after the two allegedly fell from the seventh.
articles.body: BENGALURU: A 23-year-old software engineer died and her 30-year-old boyfriend sustained serious injuries after the two allegedly fell from the seventh-floor terrace of a co-living PG accommodation in Whitefield on Sunday afternoon.The deceased, Janani, worked as a software engineer with a financial services company in Pattanduru Agrahara near Whitefield. Police identified the injured man as Manikya Velu.According to police, the two, both natives of Puducherry, had been in a relationship for six years. Velu had recently got engaged to another woman, following which he and Janani allegedly began having frequent arguments.Janani had rented a room at the PG only on Saturday and had been staying there with Velu, police said.On Sunday morning, the couple allegedly quarrelled before going to the terrace. Police suspect Janani decided to end her life by jumping from the building and, while doing so, pulled Velu along with her. The two fell from the terrace at around 12.15pm.Janani died on the spot, while Velu suffered severe injuries. He was rushed to Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre in Whitefield, where he is undergoing treatment and is reportedly out of danger.“Once Velu is in a condition to give his statement, we will question him and know further details about the incident,” a senior police officer said.Velu works with a logistics company in Puducherry. articles.title: Reddit, Roblox, and ChatGPT now targets of EU regulators.
articles.summary:
Reddit and Roblox have been designated “Very Large Online Platforms” under the Digital Services Act (DSA), while ChatGPT has been named a “Very Large Online Search Engine.” Those designations bring strict obligations to protect user safety, ensure transparency, and curb illegal content in the bloc. The companies now have four months to get their houses in order.
[Link: Commission designates ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox under Digital Services Act | https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/detail/en/ip_26_1772 | European Commission]

articles.title: AT&T accuses Charter of misleading customers about its “fiber” internet.
articles.summary:
In a lawsuit filed on Friday, AT&T claims Charter misuses the word “fiber” in its “Spectrum Fiber Broadband Network” service to “hide the fact that its network mainly connects to customers’ homes using copper wire:”
> Charter’s 100% fiber service is available only to “select residential consumers,” according to Charter’s website. It represents a small percentage of Charter’s network… The campaign deceives consumers, distorts competition, and appropriates the goodwill that AT&T’s 100% fiber network has earned.
